# tScrub

> tScrub is an open, auditable disk-sanitisation tool for regulated IT. It erases NVMe, SATA, and SCSI drives to NIST 800-88 Clear, Purge, and Destroy levels and produces a verifiable chain-of-custody report. Build your own appliance — boot from USB or PXE on hardware you already own.

- [Pricing & download](https://tscrub.com/download): Free community build, Pay-as-you-go £0.25/device, Team £99/month, Enterprise custom — sign in to issue your licence; the tScrub script downloads from your dashboard.
- [Docs](https://tscrub.com/docs): Building your appliance, running sanitisation, verifying signed reports.
- [FAQ](https://tscrub.com/faq): Certification, build-your-own-appliance, and edge-case drive handling.
- [Certificates](https://tscrub.com/dashboard/certify): Sign in and upload a report to generate a verified, printable Certificate of Destruction, and manage every certificate on your account.

## Key facts

- Supports NVMe (crypto, block, overwrite sanitise + format fallback), ATA (enhanced/standard secure erase), and SCSI sanitise.
- Handles SED/OPAL drives via PSID revert and detects BIOS Block SID lockdown (0x4286).
- Chain-of-custody report (CSV) with COCID, system serials, and per-drive final status.
- Reports can be signed (SHA-256 + Ed25519) for verifiable proof of destruction.
- NIST 800-88 alignment, GDPR, HIPAA, ISO 27001.
- Single self-contained Bash script; inspect every line.
